name: remoteagent
description: RemoteAgent — the open-source AI agent runtime for your own machines. Local policy enforcement, capability grants, sandboxed tools and a tamper-evident audit log, with egress-only networking. Control your machines from anywhere — under a policy they enforce themselves.
